newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTARUUKKI NOT TO MERGE ASVA, K-METALLI.
newsitem.headline: RAUTARUUKKI NOT TO MERGE ASVA, K-METALLI.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said on Monday it did not plan to merge its steel wholesaler Keskometalli Oy with its steel wholesale joint venture Asva Oy.
"We don't have such plans," Rautaruukki CEO Mikko Kivimaki told a news conference, when asked whether Rautaruukki would combine the two wholesalers.
Rautaruukki last June strenthened its key role on the Finnish steel wholesale market by acquiring Keskometalli from Kesko Oy .
Rautaruukki owns 20 percent of Asva Oy, and its 25 percent stake of trading house Valtameri Oy -- which in turn holds 38 percent in Asva -- makes it Valtameri's largest owner.
Asva's biggest owner is chemicals and electronics component maker Aspoyhtyma Oy with a 42 percent.
Kivimaki also said Rautaruukki had no plans to acquire any other Finnish steel wholesalers.
"We don't see any need to do such things," Kivimaki said.
Keskometalli's 1995 net sales were 950 million markka and Asva's 1995 net sales were 1.37 billion markka.
